_about: Master registry for the Chaos to Clarity Coach plugins. Each tool lives once in shared/coach/tools/ and shared/coach/index/. scripts/sync_shared.py copies every tool into the router (c2c-coach) and into its theme plugin. Edit here, then run the sync.

themes.title: Focus and Decisions
themes.summary: Your focus, your energy, and the calls you keep circling

themes.title: Leading People
themes.summary: Standards, hard conversations, delegation, decision rights, and executive hires

themes.title: Co-Founder and Board
themes.summary: The power relationships: your co-founder, your CTO, your board, and your investors

themes.title: Org and Scaling
themes.summary: Operating rhythm, org design, scorecards, and what breaks as you grow

themes.title: Growth Plays
themes.summary: Customer discovery, positioning, new markets, and breakthrough attention

themes.title: Facilitator Kit
themes.summary: Sessions you run with a group: founder hot seats and team retrospectives
